GraceDeployment.Target: Offline Debian 12 and Astra Linux installations managed by systemd, with verified full bundles and Project Control updates.
GraceDeployment.Notes: Changes are developed in short branches, merged by squash only after GRACE contract, project CI, browser, offline bundle and exact-SHA merge gate evidence. Schema rollout requires a pre-migration backup; rollback restores that verified backup and the previous application bundle.
